_comment: R-124 BREAK-GLASS trust policy TEMPLATE. Replace <ACCOUNT_ID>.
The break-glass role is the ONE principal the bucket policy exempts from its
tampering denial, so this trust policy is what stands between that exemption
and anyone in the account. It requires a same-account IAM user AND MFA.
NOT PROVEN: an operator's real assume-role flow. The provisioning run was a
root console session, which cannot demonstrate it. The operator also needs
sts:AssumeRole permission, which this file does not grant.
